title: Bound repeated owner reads in Management NL context collection

summary.defect: Management NL context collection (_mgmt_nl_collect_context) repeatedly scanned the full Telemetry owner collection (list_telemetry_summaries) per runtime binding across cockpit, trading_pulse, portfolio, and persona_fleet surfaces, and computed _mgmt_nl_trading_pulse_snippet twice when focus in ('all', '').
resolution: Added ManagementService.get_context_telemetry_summaries_for_runtimes and ManagementService.get_context_monitoring_sessions_for_bindings in services/control-plane/bff/management_read_models/service.py to read list_telemetry_summaries and list_paper_runtime_monitoring_sessions at most once per batch (or derive tenant-filtered observations from a request-scoped batch read without additional store calls) while preserving per-runtime missing->degraded and owner-error->unavailable fail-closed semantics.

Updated _project_operator_runtime_state_row_impl and _mgmt_nl_scoped_runtime_rows in services/control-plane/bff/assistant/management_service.py to batch-prefetch telemetry summaries and monitoring sessions with their owner observations.

Updated _mgmt_nl_collect_context in services/control-plane/bff/assistant/management_service.py to reuse request-scoped tenant-filtered runtime bindings, request-scoped batch telemetry summaries, and the computed trading_pulse snippet across cockpit, trading_pulse, portfolio, and persona_fleet within a single request.

acceptance_criteria_verification.criterion: _mgmt_nl_collect_context and its helper paths do not call list_telemetry_summaries repeatedly per runtime binding during a single Management NL context collection request.
When focus includes both cockpit and trading_pulse, _mgmt_nl_trading_pulse_snippet is not computed twice for identical tenant-scoped runtime bindings within the same request.
Missing telemetry for an individual runtime still marks that runtime observation degraded, and owner exceptions still mark the observation unavailable.
Both POST /bff/management/nl/ask and POST /bff/management/nl/ask/stream benefit from the bounded context read path.
Targeted tests cover multi-runtime context collection and assert bounded owner read counts plus preserved observation statuses and tenant scoping.
